note: Treg lineage stratification by Helios on Helios × Foxp3. Treg_Heliosp: stable-lineage Treg (enriched for thymus-derived Treg) — right cluster (Helios+). Treg_Heliosn: peripherally-induced or less-stable Treg — left cluster (Helios-). Helios is bimodal — boundary set at the valley between the two peaks. Foxp3 (y) is a parent-gate visual QC only (parent already Foxp3+, events stay at Foxp3-high).
tips: Treg lineage stratification by Helios (Ikaros family TF IKZF2). Treg_Heliosp: Helios+ — Helios as a strict thymic-origin marker is contested; Helios expression can also be induced in peripherally-generated Treg under certain activation conditions [Gottschalk et al. 2012, Akimova et al.], so 'Helios+' is best read as 'enriched for stable-lineage Treg'. Treg_Heliosn: Helios-. The Foxp3 y-axis is a parent-gate visual QC only — parent is already Foxp3+; the call is driven by Helios. Tissue context: under the thymic-origin interpretation, Helios- Treg would be enriched in mucosal tissues (Ileum) where microbiota-driven peripheral Treg induction occurs; this prediction depends on the contested Helios interpretation and should be confirmed from the data.
